questions.question: Polling vs interrupts?
options: Polling asks in a loop; interrupts notify via IDT dispatch
questions.explanation: Notification inverts control: CPU works until knocked.

questions.question: Masked (cli) raise does what in our model?
questions.explanation: Deferred, not lost — drained after sti.

questions.question: Unregistered vector raised?
questions.explanation: Guard makes unknown IRQs boring, as hardware demands.

questions.question: Why cli BEFORE saving registers?
options: Nested IRQ mid-save corrupts the frame
questions.explanation: Fence first, work second — ordering law.

questions.question: Why iretq, not ret?
options: Pops flags + far return atomically (no race window)
questions.explanation: Restores interrupt-flag state with the jump, indivisibly.

questions.question: Userspace cli does what on Linux?
questions.explanation: Privilege rings enforce it — the protection story preview.
